item.title: Risk Reversal | Why Americans Now Fear Vaping More Than Smoking | RegWatch
item.description: Risk perceptions of vaping in the US have shifted significantly, with 30% of adults now believing e-cigarettes are more harmful than smoking. (Published on October 19, 2026byregulatorwatch.com)
